title: Craftable Uncraftable | More Advancements
description: Ever wanted more challanges. Then this datapack adds new advancements and crafting recepies for you
body:
## Custom server datapacks

### Adding💾
This datapack adds new Advancements and crafting recipies to the game
<details>
<summary>Includes</summary>

Advanecments like:

-A hot trip (get back from the nether)

-Back to the roots (get back from the end)

-The real war pigs (kill a piglin)

-Explorer (travel 14000 blocks)


Recipies like (see screenshots for recipe):

-nametag

-farmland

-dragon egg

-obsidian

</details>

---

### How to add it?
First of, download the file from the versions category. Then start your game.

If you want to add it to a world, then simply click on the world, click edit, then open the world files, open the datapacks folder and lastly pull the .zip file that you downloaded into the folder. Congrulations you sucesfully added it to your world (you still need to enter the world and enter the command /reload)🥳.

If you want to make a new world with it, simply go on create new world. Then just go to the 3rd category that is shown up on the bar in the top screen. Then click the button Datapacks and pull the downloaded .zip file there. Click accept, then activate the pack and then create the world. Congrulations you created a new world with it🥳.

---

### Use
This datapack is adding new advancements and crafting recipies to flex (and cheat) with, or just to make minecraft easer
